sloka: तस्याभूत् सुमहांस्त्रासः कुत्सा चात्मन्यजायत ।लङ्कां प्रदहता कर्म किंस्वित् कृतमिदं मया ।। 5.55.3 ।।।।
transliteration: tasyābhūt sumahāṁstrāsaḥ kutsā cātmanyajāyata ।laṅkāṁ pradahatā karma kiṁsvit kṛtamidaṁ mayā ।। 5.55.3 ।।।।

translations.english: 'Blessed indeed are the highsouled men, who in their wisdom restrain their own anger as one would put off burning fire with water.
